meta.disclaimer: International arrival figures are from national statistics offices and tourism authorities — definitions vary (tourist vs all visitors). Use for regional context only; confirm latest reports before citing.
meta.note: Figures rounded for display. Trend notes compare to the prior published year where stated by the source.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.context: Africa supplies ~76% of arrivals; Americas +10.9% growth in 2024.

countries.name: Namibia
countries.context: ~48% visit for holiday/leisure; Germany top overseas source (~9%).

countries.name: Botswana
countries.context: High-value safari tourism — Okavango and Chobe drive premium arrivals.

countries.name: Zambia
countries.context: Victoria Falls and South Luangwa anchor inbound safari and adventure travel.

countries.name: Zimbabwe
countries.trend: Rising with Victoria Falls & Hwange recovery
countries.context: USD tourism economy; guiding excellence draws repeat safari visitors.

countries.name: Mozambique
countries.context: Bazaruto, Tofo, and Maputo lead; Gorongosa adds safari segment.

countries.name: Malawi
countries.trend: Lake tourism and Liwonde safari growth
countries.context: Warm heart of Africa brand — lake shore and bush combo itineraries.

countries.name: Lesotho
countries.context: Almost all visitors enter via South Africa — Sani Pass and pony trekking niche.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.context: No international airport — access via JNB/DUR; Ezulwini and Hlane main draws.

regional.title: Southern Africa at a glance
regional.summary: South Africa remains the regional hub (~9M arrivals) with Namibia and Botswana as flagship safari destinations above 1M each. Smaller kingdoms and lake states draw focused adventure and culture trips — often combined in multi-country loops from Johannesburg.
